secondary_comparisons: model_a, plain ICBS-h, CBS, and random-pool control; exploratory, no post-test model selection
repeat_note: Identical algorithm seed across timing repetitions
analysis: Retain all failures; family mean capped time and paired ratios; stratified family bootstrap within maps; 18 independent families, nested k variants and repeats not independent
timing_integrity: Record launch/monitor delays; preserve every attempt. Wall limit overshoot >1 second triggers a full matched instance-block replacement once only if remaining approved budget permits; otherwise flag incomplete evidence.
claim_rule: Report effect and family interval. Claim a test speedup only with no fewer solved instances and a family time-ratio interval below 1. Memory is separately measured on matched completion cases, with selection limitations.
prohibited: No test-driven retraining, feature changes, candidate-pool changes or parameter selection. No paid compute or remote publishing.
